class.name: LocalPlayers
class.brief_description: Everyone playing on this device: player 1 and any guests.

method.name: add_guest
method.description: Adds a guest. Without an argument, a plain guest whose progress the game keeps in player 1's save; given one of [member remembered], that guest, at once.

method.name: can_invite_guests
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if guests can bring their own profile here ([method invite_guest]): the online service is set up and answered.

method.name: confirm_guest
method.description: Checks the code the guest received after [method invite_guest] and adds them as a local player with their own account and saves. With [param remember], this device remembers them for next time ([member remembered]); they can revoke that from their own device. [param name] names a new account, for an address that didn't have one. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and the [code]guest[/code], and [signal guest_added] fires too.

method.name: invite_guest
method.description: Starts adding a guest who brings their own profile: they type their email address on this device, and receive a code to enter for [method confirm_guest]. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code], or [code]error[/code] as in [method Account.link_email].

method.name: remove_guest
method.description: Removes a guest from [member players] (a remembered guest stays remembered).

members.member: Everyone playing on this device: player 1 first, then any guests.
Guests and local profiles this device remembers, for a "Who's playing?" picker. Pass one to [method add_guest].

signal.name: guest_added
signal.description: Emitted when a guest who brought their profile has joined, after [method confirm_guest].
